forecaster_note: Sun: S swell leftovers + short-period NE windswell. S magnets a couple of lingering chest-high sets, everything else waist-high. Clean at dawn with offshores, light southerly switch then SE onshores through the arvo — lump and bump but light enough for a little arvo grovel. Mon: slow start, a couple of waist-high peaky waves, S-facing beaches best, clean am then NE'lies arvo. — Surfline forecaster Max Stanley-Jones, Sun 1 Nov

days.label: Today
days.note: 230 kJ (126 from a 7s NE wind wave, 88 from 10–12s S leftovers) — small, peaky waist-high; chest at the S magnets. Clean W offshore at dawn, SE onshore from midday: surf 6–10am around the 7:09am low.
days.surfline_text: S swell leftovers mix with some recent short period NE windswell. Southerly magnets see a couple lingering chest high sets, all other breaks are waist high.  Clean at dawn with these offshore winds, then a light southerly switch leads to SE onshores persisting through the afternoon - they'll add lump and bump but should stay light enough for a little arvo grovel.

days.surfline_text: Bit of a slow start to the week as we'll only see a couple waist high waves from the small swell mix - peaky. S facing beaches will probably hold the best shape.  Clean in the morning with offshores and that low tide will help banks out - then NE'lies will send us running for cover in the arvy.
